findings.summary: oldestDays is floored at 1 instead of 0, contradicting the stated fix intent.
findings.mechanism: Math.max(1, ...) forces a minimum of 1 even when every stuckRow was first observed in this very run (diff = 0). The task explicitly asked for flooring at zero; using 1 means a same-run item now always reports 'stuck 1 day' instead of 0 days, which is wrong in the opposite direction of the original negative-number bug — it fabricates a nonzero age where none exists.
